articles.summary: H&P announced consolidated revenue of $1.1 billion, reflecting 6% sequential growth. Consolidated net loss attributable to Helmerich & Payne, Inc. of $490 million, or $4.91 loss per share, which includes a $610 million non-cash asset impairment charge for assets primarily located in the Middle East. Adjusted for select items, adjusted net income(1) was $36 million, or $0.36 per share.
articles.title: H&P, Inc. Announces Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Results
